newsitem.title: USA: Kimberly-Clark awards Foote, Cone $25 mln account.
newsitem.headline: Kimberly-Clark awards Foote, Cone $25 mln account.

text.p: Foote, Cone & Belding said Friday it has been named agency of record for Kimberly-Clark Corp's consumer tissue division throughout Europe and the United Kingdom.
With billings of $25 million, the appointment makes Foote, Cone & Belding the company's sole agency for all of its Kleenex brand facial and bathroom tissues in Europe.
Foote, Cone & Belding, a subsidiary of True North Communications Inc, had competed for the contract with incumbent agency J. Walter Thompson, a WPP Group Plc unit.
Foote, Cone & Belding has been one of Kimberly-Clark's primary agencies since 1923.
True North had 1995 billings of $7.5 billion.
Shares of True North were trading up 1/4 to 23-1/4.
